## EA Media Tools 2.4.0 - jaguar

### Subtitle discovery and import

- Single-file, multi-file, and recursive folder modes now scan beside each video for UTF-8 SRT, ASS, SSA, and WebVTT files with the same basename.
- Exact names such as `Show A.srt` match `Show A.mkv`; tokenized names such as `Show A.en.default.srt` also derive language, default, forced, and hearing-impaired settings.
- Matching is directory-local, so subtitles cannot attach to a same-named episode in another season folder.
- The subtitle tab can import multiple UTF-8 files manually. Files without language or flag tokens begin as undefined with no special dispositions and remain editable.
- Imported text subtitles convert to `mov_text` for MP4 output.

### Metadata and dispositions

- Audio and subtitle languages can be changed during ordinary conversion, including undefined streams.
- Metadata-only mode can import subtitles while safely replacing the original container through a verified temporary output.
- Audio and subtitle output each allow one primary flagged track. If default and forced were scanned on different languages, the first flagged track inherits both; SDH/hearing-impaired flags remain independent on any track.

### NVIDIA and preset improvements

- All ten CUVID formats exposed by the bundled Jellyfin FFmpeg are detected: AV1, H.264, HEVC, MJPEG, MPEG-1, MPEG-2, MPEG-4, VC-1, VP8, and VP9.
- Supported NVIDIA auto-crops run in the decoder without leaving GPU memory. Unavailable formats retain generic NVDEC and use the protected download/crop/CUDA-upload bridge.
- New valid `presets.ini` sections automatically appear as predefined presets. Music Video remains visible only in Music Video mode.
- Regular now receives the same spatial adaptive-quantization dark-scene improvement as the streaming and Music Video presets while retaining existing speed and bitrate limits.

### Reliability

- Windows option toggles no longer blank the renderer.
- Selecting media or moving between queued sources no longer creates a `converted` directory. Output directories are created only after an encode queue is accepted.
- Queue finalization force-closes only child processes spawned and tracked by EA Media Tools; unrelated FFmpeg sessions are never selected by process name.

### Validation

- Added coverage for UTF-8 validation, exact and directory-local sidecar matching, all supported text subtitle formats, primary disposition inheritance, owned-process cleanup, CUVID format detection, and dynamic predefined presets.
- Lint, native and compatibility TypeScript checks, unit tests, and Windows x64 production packaging pass.

[Review changes since v2.3.1](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.3.1...v2.4.0).
